## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest correct change that addresses it.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `bun run ci`, or explained why a check could not run.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated public documentation or the changelog when needed.
- [ ] I did not include generated files or unrelated changes.
